newsitem.title: USA: Hoechst Celanese Texas plant rocked by explosion.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst Celanese Texas plant rocked by explosion.

text.p: Hoechst Celanese Corp was investigating damage to a methanol processing unit at its Clear Lake, Texas plant southeast of Houston following an explosion in a vent line on Tuesday, a plant spokesman said.
The 0700 CST explosion could be felt several miles away but there were no injuries in the explosion, which occured a day after the unit was taken down for planned maintenance, the spokesman said.
"The process unit was down at the time. We are currently investigating what happened. There were no fires," he said. "We have the situation under control."
The unit has a rated capacity of 1.3 billion pounds per year, and is operated in a joint venture with Valero Energy Corp to produce methyl tertiary butyl ether, a gasoline additive.
